description: This file contains the implementation of the Python bindings and initialization functions for the distributed autograd component in PyTorch, including module imports, class definitions, and method bindings for autograd context management and backward pass execution.

classes.name: DistAutogradContext
classes.description: Represents the distributed autograd context, providing access to context ID, send/recv functions, and worker IDs.

methods.name: _context_id
methods.description: Returns the context ID of the autograd context.

methods.name: _recv_functions
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping worker IDs to their corresponding autograd functions.

methods.name: _send_functions
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of send functions for the autograd context.

methods.name: _known_worker_ids
methods.description: Returns a list of known worker IDs in the autograd context.

methods.name: _new_context
methods.description: Creates and returns a new autograd context.

methods.name: _release_context
methods.description: Releases the autograd context with the specified ID.

methods.name: _is_valid_context
methods.description: Checks if a context is valid for a given worker ID.

methods.name: _retrieve_context
methods.description: Retrieves the autograd context with the specified ID.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the autograd container with a worker ID.

methods.name: _get_debug_info
methods.description: Retrieves debug information from the distributed engine.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Performs the distributed backward pass given a context ID and root tensors.

methods.name: get_gradients
methods.description: Retrieves the gradients accumulated in a specific autograd context.
